name: Driving techno
pattern:
setcpm(130/4)
stack(
  s("bd*4"),
  s("~ ~ cp ~").gain(0.8),
  s("hh*8").gain(0.4),
  note("a1 a1 e2 a1").s("sawtooth").lpf(600).gain(0.7),
  note("<Am F C G>").s("sawtooth").struct("1 ~ ~ ~").lpf(1200).release(0.4).gain(0.35)
)
progression: Am - F - C - G (i - VI - III - VII)
description: Four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 3, straight 8th hats. Bass and chords are both in A natural minor, so the harmony is unambiguous for key detection.

source.note: No licensed source exists for this genre — Strudel's drum corpus has no techno, trap, ambient or jazz entries, and the community collections are unlicensed. Written by hand; the harmony is stated explicitly in `key` and `progression` so it can be checked against music theory rather than against this project's own analyzer.
